name: meo-bom
description: Mèo Bom: a Vietnamese-first 3D online card game for 2 to 5 players

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @meobom/server" "npm run dev -w @meobom/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @meobom/web && npm run build -w @meobom/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
